entries.title: Balatro GBA
entries.description:
A non-profit fan demake of Balatro, the poker roguelike deckbuilder by LocalThunk, published by Playstack. It aims to recreate the original as accurately as possible, including its visuals. It is a minimal tech demo meant for people who already own and know the original game, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by LocalThunk or Playstack. The code comes from many contributors; the sprites and backgrounds are based on the original game's art, and the music is arranged from LouisF's original soundtrack.

Controls: A picks a card or makes a selection, B deselects all cards, L plays the hand

entries.title: Celeste Classic 2 GBA
entries.description:
A port of Celeste Classic 2, the PICO-8 platformer made by Maddy Thorson, Noel Berry and Lena Raine for Celeste's third anniversary. The port aims to be as accurate as possible to the original: gameplay is the same, with some very minor graphical changes, and the PICO-8 audio was converted to tracker files for maxmod. It was tested on emulators, real GBA hardware and the 3DS Virtual Console.

Controls: D-pad moves, A or L jumps, B or R grapples, SELECT pauses. Hold L+R+Down+B and press START to reset the game.

entries.title: Celeste Classic GBA
entries.description:
A port of Celeste Classic, the PICO-8 platformer by Maddy Thorson and Noel Berry. It is an almost direct conversion of the original, with minor graphical changes.

Controls: A jumps, B dashes, SELECT toggles screen shake, and L+R+SELECT+START restarts the game. Pressing L+R+START on the title screen unlocks the second air dash from the start, and the end screen then shows "cheater".

entries.title: GBA Microjam '23 game
entries.description: Trick or treat! The GBA Microjam '23 is a spooky microgame collection for the Game Boy Advance created by the members of the gbadev.net community. If you've played WarioWare you'll know what to expect! (If you haven't... then heck, why not download it anyway and see what it's all about!?). This project was a huge collaboration which we've never tried before, and we're super happy with how it turned out! With almost 30 microgames included, there's plenty to surprise you and keep you on your toes. Huge congrats to everyone who took part. We hope you had fun!

entries.title: GBAtris
entries.description:
A classic-style falling block puzzle game. It shares some code with the author's earlier terminal game, termtris, and keeps a high score table with name entry. The background music is a short loop from Greig Stewart's laser harp performance of Korobeiniki.

Controls: D-pad left/right moves the block, D-pad down makes it fall faster, B or D-pad up drops it immediately, A rotates it. START pauses, SELECT starts a new game, and L or R toggles the music.

entries.title: Lab Sound GBA
entries.description: LabSound is a Game Boy Advanced music creation project that aims to awaken the artist in all of us. With a design similar to FL Studio or eJay, it allows you to compose your own sound loops, whether or not accompanied by catchy rhythms. Anyone can produce a complete music of about 2-3 min, utilizing the pre-programmed rhythm machine system and add your own melodies or drum sounds over it.

entries.title: Luma
entries.description: Luma is a laser based sliding puzzle game for the GBA. Slide batteries, lasers and mirrors around to light the targets within the given shift count. With 128 levels Luma will keep you occupied for hours and test your puzzling skills to the max. Play in Normal mode and try to complete the levels within a designated number of shifts, and return to where you left off using level codes on each level. Or if you are feeling like a more casual game play in Practice mode to test any of the levels with no shift limits.
